headline: Executive order bars federal agencies from using commercial spyware that poses risks to US national security.
what_it_does: This order limits the federal government's use of commercial spyware, which is hacking or surveillance software sold by private companies. It prohibits US government agencies from using such tools when they pose risks to national security. No summary was provided, so details about how agencies decide which spyware is covered, and any exceptions, are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: They are barred from using commercial spyware that poses national security risks.

who_it_affects.group: Companies that make or sell commercial spyware
who_it_affects.how: Their products may not be bought or used by the US government if they fall under the order's restrictions.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed March 27, 2023; executive orders generally take effect when signed unless they say otherwise.
